explanation: Maintain the next unread index in each source. Each served ID must consume the next ID from exactly one source.
correctness: At every step the consumed prefixes are exactly the source orders already served. Any different next ID violates at least one source order; exhausting both sources proves exact coverage.
walkthrough: For takeOut=[8,3], dineIn=[5,9], served=[5,8,3,9], consume 5 from the dine-in head, then 8 and 3 from takeout, then 9 from dine-in. Both source positions reach their ends exactly, so return true.
